{{Short description|Area of differential geometry and topology}}
In [[mathematics]], '''spin geometry''' is the area of [[differential geometry]] and [[topology]] where objects like [[spin manifold]]s and [[Dirac operator]]s, and the various associated index theorems have come to play a fundamental role both in [[mathematics]] and in [[mathematical physics]].

An important generalisation is the theory of [[Symplectic geometry|symplectic]] Dirac operators in symplectic spin geometry and [[symplectic topology]], which have become important fields of mathematical research.
